title: Grizzli Winery
gap: No pricing or duration for wine tastings or tours
blurb: Grizzli Winery is a family-owned and operated estate winery in the Okanagan Valley. They produce wines from hand-harvested grapes showcasing British Columbia's wine country. The winery hosts seasonal events and features an art gallery and a dining venue called 31 Charkay offering contemporary Canadian cuisine and wine pairings.
